component.name: Keynear
component.summary: Direct, end-to-end encrypted continuity between Linux and Android

description.p: Keynear links a Linux desktop and an Android phone over Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) and local Wi-Fi QUIC with zero cloud accounts and zero relay servers.

Features include resumable 60 KiB checkpointed file and directory streaming, privacy-aware clipboard and one-time code synchronization, PipeWire and MPRIS2 Bluetooth headset handoff, and on-demand virtual filesystem browsing.

Adds checkpointed 60 KiB resumable transfers, on-demand Linux FUSE3 and Android DocumentsProvider virtual filesystem browsing, offline Plus Jakarta Sans font assets, and official desktop and mobile packaging definitions.
